metric_semantics.promotion_load_count: promotions section loads, one BeltService.list_ladders read each: the miss, the shared concurrent miss and the post-invalidation miss; none on the cache hit or the denied request
metric_semantics.follow_up_query_count: uncached leads reads for follow-ups on the six authorized requests; two each, because the six oldest due leads are all overdue and more are due, so Home also counts overdue leads separately
metric_semantics.materialize_rpc_count: materialize_recurring_class_sessions calls; zero because the faked facts already list today's classes
metric_semantics.returned_row_count: rows returned by Auth-context, contact, follow-up and promotions table executes, plus one per facts RPC object; Auth response bytes are not included
metric_semantics.provider_response_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of canonical table and facts RPC envelopes, counted internally and never emitted
metric_semantics.total_duration_ms: wall time for seven real GET /dashboard/home invocations against fake provider I/O, including belt eligibility on each promotions load; each distinct fake table query is matched once and every execute is counted; excludes bearer-token verification and SQL/network cost
metric_semantics.max_stage_duration_ms: maximum successful endpoint invocation including serialization
metric_semantics.slow_backend_stage_count: successful endpoint invocations above backend_stage_threshold_ms; descriptive evidence only, not a pass/fail budget, browser long-task, or INP metric
metric_semantics.peak_rss_bytes: whole fixture-process peak resident memory sampled after fixture construction and endpoint exercise; not endpoint-only allocation or deployed backend memory
